judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` correctly—compiling schemas with `ajv`, caching dynamic schemas via `WeakMap`, and returning descriptive `ToolResponse` rejections without leaking values. However, the candidate stopped halfway through its own Definition of Done (leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree). It is missing several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool throw, single compilation across 10 calls) and did not add the test to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, placing a few tests in a non-requested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` only documents the registration-time compilation rather than the `execute` validation behavior and migration note.
